description: Transform your retail data into visual insights. Planogram Viewer renders your shelf photos directly from image URLs and overlays interactive, color-coded bounding boxes to analyze retail execution, stock and Share of Shelf. Key features High-definition zoom & pan: inspect every detail of your shelf execution with intuitive mouse controls. Toggle overlay mode: instantly switch between the clean photo and the data overlay with the Eye button to spot-check compliance. Interactive overlays: draw boxes from coordinates (X, Y, Width, Height) and color each one dynamically from your data using hex codes. Rich tooltips: native Power BI tooltips showing any fields you choose. Selection & context menu: click boxes to cross-filter your report; right-click for standard Power BI options. Licensing The free version renders up to 25 boxes per image, so you can evaluate the product with your real data. The Pro License removes this limit and supports large planograms with thousands of boxes per image. Licenses are purchased per user through Microsoft AppSource and assigned in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Embedded, Publish-to-web and Report Server deployments are not covered by AppSource licensing and require a separate commercial license — contact info@invenia.es.
